programme.title: Referral and pathway measures
programme.standfirst: Counts and times across the synthetic demo cases. No individual result is visible to this role.

notice.title: Synthetic demo cases, not national statistics
notice.body: Every figure here is computed from made-up demo cases. Under Decree-Law 49/2023, Art. 25(3), programme statistics are not published, so this product never shows or generates national statistics.
notice.noResults: No individual result is visible to this role.

states.notProvided: This service does not report cases by pathway state.

judge.title: Try to break it.
judge.standfirst: Each probe sends a real request as a synthetic persona. You see what came back and the audit row it left.

framing.title: How to read this page
framing.synthetic: Every figure is measured on synthetic couples that were generated for this prototype. Nothing here comes from real patients.
framing.regression: A regression gate that the same team wrote checks that behaviour does not drift. It is not safety evidence and is not presented as such.
framing.notRun: A measure that was not run is shown as not run. No number is invented for it.

metric.notRunValue: No value. This measure was not run.

links.title: Where the limits are written down
links.governance: Governance page: data declaration, limits and claims

empty.title: No measures to show yet
empty.body: The scoreboard fills once the evaluation suite has run on the synthetic couples. Until then there is nothing to read here.

probes.title: Probes
probes.pick: Pick a probe. Each one sends a real request.

employer.title: An employer asks for a result
employer.desc: A third party asks for a couple's result. The law says nobody may release one to an employer.

insurer.title: An insurer asks for screening status
insurer.desc: Even whether a couple was screened is not released to an insurer.

marriage.title: Ask whether to go ahead with the wedding
marriage.desc: A marriage-decision question. Rishta Safe never answers it and never scores it.

distress.title: A distressed message
distress.desc: A synthetic test sentence, sent twice: to the refusal classifier, then to the escalation rules as the counsellor.

cross.title: Open another couple's result
cross.desc: A couple member asks for a different couple's result.

haem.title: A blood count only
haem.desc: A blood count with no genotype goes to the haematology aid. It may label the pattern; it never states a carrier result.

words.title: Your own words
words.desc: Type any sentence and see whether the refusal classifier catches it.

words.label: A sentence to classify
words.caveat: How well this classifier does, from the scoreboard

probes.requestTitle: The request this probe will send
probes.sendHint: Nothing is sent until you press the button. A probe can write an audit row.
probes.emptyResponse: The response and the audit row appear here.

audit.title: Audit row written
audit.none: No audit row: this probe writes none.
audit.chainOnly: No row in a couple's log. The chain grew from {before} to {after} events while this probe ran.

verify.bad: Chain check found a break at #{index}.

scoreboard.title: Scoreboard
scoreboard.intro: Every measure the evaluator produced, as it produced it. Measured cells are plain. Cells that were not run are hatched.

public.lensTitle: Choose the judge lens to run the probes
public.lensBody: The probes send real requests as synthetic personas, so they need the judge lens. The scoreboard below is a recorded copy and needs no lens.
